lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in at least four distinguishable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs in the mid-lateral region exhibit the highest pixel intensity and largest diameters, forming a regular matrix-like distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance are visible, aligned with the columns of blobs. The blobs appear as primary nodes at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal axes of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the dorsal-lateral interface. Each ridge is defined by a narrow band of high-intensity pixels on its upper edge followed by a sharp gradient into a shadow region immediately below.
